protocol.measured: complete workload calls plus checksum consumption and wall-clock loop checks
protocol.counts: self counts partition all samples; inclusive counts deduplicate recursion and overlap between functions
protocol.locations: source module from esbuild section markers; bundleLine is an emitted bundle line
protocol.limits: sampling is approximate, includes profiler and runtime overhead, and is not a benchmark speedup measurement

workloadSet.unit: one chartWorkload call, including every CHART_CASES input
one housesWorkload call, including every HOUSE_CASES and HOUSE_SYSTEMS pair
one transitScanWorkload call over the complete TRANSIT_CASE interval
